name: Should I add a half-bath or a full bathroom to my home?

mainEntity.name: Should I add a half-bath or a full bathroom to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main decision factor is how your home will use the space. A half-bath, or powder room, includes only a toilet and sink. It requires minimal square footage—often as little as 18 to 25 square feet—making it ideal for guests near living areas. A full bathroom includes a toilet, sink, and either a shower or bathtub, typically requiring 36 to 40 square feet or more. Choosing a full bath adds greater long-term flexibility for growing families or overnight guests, but it requires larger plumbing supply lines, dedicated venting, and more floor space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a half-bath to serve guests in compact spaces. Choose a full bath if you need daily bathing capacity for family or guests, which requires more square footage and venting.
